title: Chapter 36 Lu Daosheng Lobbying
content:
Chapter 36 Lu Daosheng Lobbying

"alright."

Just as everyone was arguing, Old Yang spoke.

Suddenly, everyone stopped one after another.

"Duan Heng, the other party is willing to fight against the evil demon clan together."

Mr. Yang looked at Duan Heng and said.

He doesn't care whether the other party is strong or not, he only cares whether the other party will help.

Upon hearing this, Duan Heng nodded repeatedly.

"Old Yang, this is what I want to say. The other party has agreed to me that when the evil demon invades, they will definitely come to help."

Hearing this, Mr. Yang smiled.

"Okay, okay, okay."

He said three times in a row, which is enough to show how happy Mr. Yang is.

Looking at the quiet starry sky, Old Yang slowly said: "The peace of this endless years of Hongmeng Universe was exchanged for the lives of our ancestors. Now, it is time for us to come."

Everyone around them looked solemn.

And at this moment, two powerful people in the causal realm came to everyone with a gloomy expression.

Seeing the expressions of the two, everyone frowned.

"Brother Gu, what's going on?"

One person asked.

These two people went to the top forces in the universe not long ago to convey information.

To be precise, it is to let the top forces in the universe come to help when evil demons invade.

But when they saw the two of them, everyone felt a little confused.

At this time, one of them said in a deep voice: "Those forces are just talking and have no intention of making efforts."

Hearing this, everyone's mood suddenly sank to the bottom.

Do these short-sighted guys, don’t you know what it means to lose your lips and have cold teeth?

Could it be that the entire universe can only rely on these people?

Old Yang sighed, "No matter how much they are, you can come as many people as you can."

Upon hearing this, everyone stopped saying anything.

After all, the high-end combat power of the entire universe is here, and it is not that they can't do it without those forces.

But they were so disappointed.

This is not just their Hongmeng universe.

.........

A certain galaxy.

In a very powerful force.

"Sect Master, evil demons invade the universe, are we really not going?"

One person in the sect said worriedly.

Hearing this, the sect leader snorted softly, "The Hongmeng Universe is vast and boundless. I am one of my sects. It's harmless. Even if they can't stand it, it's their business."

These words are extremely selfish remarks.

However, the people around him nodded one after another.

"What the sect leader said."

In the darkness, above the void, when he heard the words of several people in the hall, Lu Daosheng shook his head in disappointment.

He originally came here to persuade the forces here to fight against the evil demon clan together.

Because he doesn't want those heroes who struggle to stay at the boundaries of the universe to be heartbroken.

For this reason, he did not hesitate to leave in person.

I thought that the evil demon clan invaded the entire Hongmeng universe, and then the creatures in the universe would share the same hatred against the enemy. I only needed to explain the interests and these forces would understand.

But obviously, it's not that simple.

However, Lu Daosheng did not give up.

What I lack the least is strength and resources.

Since these forces cannot take the initiative to help, we can only use other methods.

Lu Daosheng looked at the deepest part of the sect below.

There, there is an extremely powerful and ancient existence.

Buzz —

At the deepest point of the sect, an old man who was about to die suddenly opened his eyes.

The next moment, the old man broke through the barrier and appeared outside the cultivation room.

"who!"

Just now, he noticed an extremely dangerous aura.

At this time, Lu Daosheng appeared in front of the old man.

Cause and effect realm!

No wonder it can attract those people at the border barrier to come for help. A strong man in the causal realm is indeed very attractive.

But they ignored one thing.

The old man seemed to have come to an end and could only stay in his life and seek more life and opportunities.

How could such a big battle take place?

That's why they hit a wall.

But Lu Daosheng is different.

"How about making a deal?"

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

It seemed as if he could see Lu Daosheng's extraordinaryness. The old man did not lose his temper, but asked in a low voice: "Let me tell me."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng slowly took out a crystal stone.

There are countless pure auras permeated on it.

Seeing this thing, the old man suddenly became short of breath and stared at the crystal stone in Lu Daosheng's hand with greedily.

"what do you want to do?"

The old man said anxiously.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Fight against the evil demon clan."

Hearing this, the old man hesitated.

The things in front of you are indeed very tempting, but if you are not careful, you will even lose your life.

Seeing that the old man was still hesitating, Lu Daosheng took out another item.

I saw that it was a pill full of light fragrance.

In an instant, the old man almost didn't saliva flow out.

Just after smelling it, my realm was moved.

What if I eat it.

"Okay, I agree!"

This time, the old man directly agreed.

"But you have to give me this pill first."

Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Yes, but then you can't leave alone."

The old man said directly: "I will take the strong men of the entire sect, and the evil demon clan dares to offend my Hongmeng Universe."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said nothing more, and then handed the pill and crystal to the old man.

"Remember what you said."

Then, Lu Daosheng disappeared on the spot.

Watching Lu Daosheng leave, the old man suddenly became excited.

The next moment, the old man swallowed the pill directly.

In an instant, the huge medicinal power continued to bombard the old man's veins, and the old man's breath began to surge.

Feeling the growth of strength, the old man couldn't help laughing.

"This, this is the breath of the ancestor!"

Suddenly, countless strong men in the sect rushed here.

Seeing the old man, everyone's face was full of surprise.

"The ancestor has broken through!"

"Hahaha, the ancestor has broken through, great."

It was unknown how long it took for the old man's breath to gradually calm down.

At this time, the sect master trotted to the old man, with a smile on his face.

"Ancestor, you, "

Before he finished speaking, the old man interrupted him.

"Pass my order, the entire sect enters the first level state, when the evil demon clan descends, all the emperor realm strongmen will rush to the border of the universe."

Hearing this, the sect master was shocked.

"Yes, ancestor."

After taking a deep breath, he quickly agreed.

The ancestor has spoken, how dare he say anything.

And the ancestor has now taken another step forward, and he dare not say a word.

Fight if you want, I will just stay away when the time comes.

And at the original place, the old man looked at the place where Lu Daosheng left, his eyes full of solemnity. He knew nothing about Lu Daosheng, but the other party was so generous.

Obviously, that was an existence that he could never provoke.

So, to fight against the evil demon clan, he readily agreed.

It was not his confidence in himself, but his confidence in Lu Daosheng. He believed that when the time came, the other party would never watch the Hongmeng Universe fail.

.........

In the starry sky, Lu Daosheng was looking for the next force.

That pill was bought in the system store. It was very powerful, enough for the old man to break through to the realm of life and death.

However, medicine is three-point poison.

The realm improved by taking drugs is not the best after all.

This is also why Lu Daosheng did not directly use pills to force his subordinates to improve their realm, but chose to let them practice by themselves.

However, before the evil demons invaded, Lu Daosheng still gave them a good special training.

This strength is not enough to face the evil demons.

Soon, Lu Daosheng came to another place with extremely strong strength.

"I'm sorry, our sect does not want to put the sect in danger."

In the face of Lu Daosheng's invitation, the sect master in front of him decisively refused.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned.

"You should know that the evil demons invaded the entire Hongmeng Universe, including your Dayan Galaxy."

"So what?"

The sect master of Dayan Sect said indifferently.

Looking at the attitude of the man in front of him, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

The next moment, a trace of terrifying aura emanated from Lu Daosheng's body.

However, it disappeared in a flash.

But even if it was only for a moment, the entire Great Flame Sect felt it clearly.

In front of Lu Daosheng, the Great Flame Sect's Sect Master looked a little terrified.

The opponent's strength was so terrifying.

"You,"

And at this moment, another breath sounded from the depths of the sect.

"It's the ancestor!"

Everyone in the sect exclaimed when they felt this breath.

The next moment, an old man in a fiery red robe appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, the old man frowned.

"I wonder who you are?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the old man and said, "It doesn't matter who I am, but, do you, the Great Flame Sect, really not want to fight against the evil demon clan together with the Hongmeng Universe?"

Hearing this, the old man's pupils shrank.

"The evil demon clan is coming again!?"

On the side, the Great Flame Sect's Sect Master lowered his head tightly.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng also understood.

It turned out that the old man didn't know about this.

"A hundred years later, the evil demon clan will break the boundary barrier of the universe and completely invade the Hongmeng universe."

Hearing this, the old man's face suddenly became extremely gloomy.

Taking a deep breath, the old man said in a deep voice: "When the time comes, my Great Yan Sect will definitely help you with all its strength!"

Looking at the old man's resolute eyes, Lu Daosheng was stunned for a moment, and then he smiled.

"Okay."

Then, Lu Daosheng handed the old man a storage ring.

"These are enough for you to break through to the realm of life and death."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng left here.

Looking at the storage ring in his hand, the old man was stunned in the same place.

And when he saw the things in the storage ring, the old man's breathing suddenly became rapid.

"Ancestor,..."

"Shut up! From now on, you are no longer the leader of the Great Yan Sect!"

"Ah!?"

"Come on! Take him down."

Then, two strong men directly pulled him down.

The old man put away the ring, looked up at the starry sky, and murmured: "Ancestor, your descendants will definitely avenge you for the past."
